verdict.rationale: Linear documents issue creation (the issueCreate GraphQL mutation, pre-filled creation URLs) and assignee ownership of issues (My Issues → Assigned, assignedIssues, humans remaining the assignee when agents are delegated). Community users confirm it quickly captures features and bugs. Due dates on individual tasks are never evidenced; the only date shown is a project target date. missing for 10: documented per-issue due dates, explicit docs on assigning issues to teammates in the UI, independent hands-on corroboration of assignment workflows

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates

citations.quote: Open issue creation with pre-filled fields from a URL
so humans maintain ownership while agents act on their behalf
a great tool to quickly capture features and bugs
